listen_addresses.description: IP addresses or hostnames PostgreSQL will listen on for client connections. Use '*' for all.

port.description: TCP port number to accept connections on.

max_connections.description: Maximum number of concurrent connections allowed.

shared_buffers.description: Amount of shared memory used for caching data. Typically 25% of total RAM on a dedicated server.

work_mem.description: Memory per operation (e.g., sort, hash). Larger values speed complex queries but consume memory per connection.

maintenance_work_mem.description: Maximum memory for maintenance operations (e.g., VACUUM, CREATE INDEX).

effective_cache_size.description: Estimated total memory available for disk caching (including OS cache). Helps planner choose index scans.

wal_buffers.description: Shared memory for WAL (write-ahead log) data before being written to disk.

checkpoint_completion_target.description: Time allowed to spread checkpoint writes (0.0 = immediate, 1.0 = only at end). 0.9 is typical.

max_wal_size.description: Maximum WAL size before forced checkpoint.

min_wal_size.description: Minimum WAL size to retain for reuse.

logging_collector.description: Enable collection of log output into files (required for log rotation and centralized logs).

log_directory.description: Directory for log files (relative to data_directory or absolute).

log_filename.description: Filename pattern for log files using strftime codes.

log_min_messages.description: Minimum message level logged (e.g., DEBUG5, INFO, WARNING, ERROR).

log_min_duration_statement.description: Log statements taking longer than this many milliseconds (set to -1 to disable).

timezone.description: Server-side default timezone for timestamps without explicit TZ.

locale.description: Default locale for collation, formatting, and number representation.

lc_messages.description: Locale for system messages and error strings.

server_encoding.description: Database server character encoding. Must match client encoding expectations.

hba_file.description: Path to the HBA (host-based authentication) configuration file.

ident_file.description: Path to the user name mapping configuration file.

max_parallel_workers_per_gather.description: Max parallel workers per parallel query (requires max_worker_processes ≥ this).

max_parallel_maintenance_workers.description: Max parallel workers for maintenance (e.g., CREATE INDEX, VACUUM).

max_worker_processes.description: Total background worker processes (required for parallel queries, logical replication, extensions).

replication_primary_host.description: Connection info for primary server when this instance is a standby (e.g., 'host=primary port=5432 user=repl password=secret').

replication_standby_hosts.description: List of standby hosts allowed to connect for streaming replication. Each item includes host and auth_method.

host.description: Hostname or IP of standby server.

hba_rules.description: List of pg_hba.conf rules (not the full file). Each rule specifies access control for clients.

database.description: Database(s) this rule applies to (comma-separated, 'all', 'sameuser', etc.).

user.description: User(s) this rule applies to (comma-separated, 'all', 'sameuser', etc.).

address.description: Client IP/network (e.g., '192.168.1.0/24'). Omit for local sockets.

wal_compression.description: Compress WAL during archiving or replication: 'on', 'off', or 'pglz'.

synchronous_standby_names.description: List of standby names for synchronous replication (e.g., 'FIRST 1 (standby1, standby2)').

wal_level.description: WAL level: 'minimal', 'replica', 'logical'. 'replica' enables hot standby; 'logical' enables logical decoding.

max_wal_senders.description: Max WAL sender processes (for streaming replication). Requires wal_level ≥ replica.

wal_sender_timeout.description: Timeout (ms) for WAL sender disconnecting inactive standbys.

shared_preload_libraries.description: List of shared libraries to load at server startup (e.g., ['pg_stat_statements', 'auto_explain']).

archive_mode.description: Enable archiving of WAL segments (required for point-in-time recovery).

archive_command.description: Shell command to copy WAL files to archive location. Use %p (source) and %f (filename).

archive_timeout.description: Force WAL switch every N seconds to ensure archival of in-progress segments (0 disables).

recovery_target_lsn.description: Recover to a specific WAL LSN.

recovery_target_time.description: Recover to a specific timestamp (ISO 8601 format).

recovery_target_xid.description: Recover to a specific transaction ID.

recovery_target_name.description: Recover to a named restore point.

logical_decoding.description: Enable logical decoding (required for logical replication slots and publications).

logical_replication_publications.description: List of logical replication publications to define at startup.

logical_replication_subscriptions.description: List of logical replication subscriptions to create at startup.

provider.description: Connection info to primary (e.g., 'host=primary port=5432 dbname=app user=repl password=secret').

default_statistics_target.description: Default statistics target for columns (1–10000). Higher = more precise plans but longer ANALYZE.

random_page_cost.description: Planner's estimate of relative cost of random disk access. Lower = favor index scans more aggressively.

jit.description: Enable JIT compilation for queries (improves complex queries on large datasets).

tcp_keepalives_idle.description: Seconds of idle before TCP starts sending keepalives.

tcp_keepalives_count.description: Number of TCP keepalive probes before connection is dropped.

ssl.description: SSL mode: 'off', 'allow', 'prefer', 'require'. Requires ssl_cert_file and ssl_key_file.

ssl_cert_file.description: Path to SSL certificate (relative to data_directory or absolute).

ssl_key_file.description: Path to SSL private key (relative to data_directory or absolute).

ssl_ca_file.description: Optional: Path to SSL CA certificate for verifying client certs (relative or absolute).
